subject: Where are my shoes?

subject: Returning headphones

body: There is a charge on my card from you for $39.99 that I absolutely did not make. I have never ordered a smart plug in my life. Somebody has got hold of my card details. I want this reversed today and I want to know how this happened.

subject: Question before I order

body: Hi there, I'd like to return my order please, it didn't work out. Let me know what I need to do.

subject: bought the wrong thing

subject: no sign of my order

subject: laptop sleeve fell apart
